title: Intel D270 GPU AI Accelerator–Up to 480 GB LPDDR5X
summary: Intel's D270 data center GPU is a new AI accelerator featuring up to 480 GB of LPDDR5X memory, aimed at large-scale inference and training workloads. The Hacker News discussion (280 points, 156 comments) debates its competitive positioning against NVIDIA and AMD, memory bandwidth trade-offs, and software ecosystem challenges.
